calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.40(2)(B), an ancillary building containing a garden suite located less than 7.5 m from the residential building on the lot has a maximum height of 4.0 metres.
calculation_handling.gaps: Distance to the residential building is a scenario value.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.40(2)(B), an ancillary building containing a garden suite located 7.5 m or more from the residential building on the lot has a maximum height of 6.3 metres.
calculation_handling.gaps: Distance to the residential building is a scenario value.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.40(3), an ancillary building containing a garden suite may have a maximum of two storeys, subject to the height limits in (1).
Antennae on the roof of a garden suite building may exceed its permitted maximum height by 1.0 metres.
calculation_handling.gaps: Height projection allowance for a rooftop element; there is no DSL target for element projection above the height limit, so 1.0 m is listed as not expressed.

units.disclosure: Antennae may rise up to 1.0 m above a garden suite's height limit; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Flagpoles on the roof of a garden suite building may exceed its permitted maximum height by 1.0 metres.
calculation_handling.gaps: Rooftop element projection; no DSL target.

units.disclosure: Flagpoles may rise up to 1.0 m above a garden suite's height limit; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Parapets for a green roof on a garden suite building may exceed its permitted maximum height by 1.0 metres if they are no closer than 1.0 metre to the main walls.
calculation_handling.gaps: Rooftop element projection with a set-in condition from the main walls; no DSL target or condition variable.

units.disclosure: Green-roof parapets set back 1.0 m from the walls may rise up to 1.0 m above a garden suite's height limit; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.gaps: Rooftop element projection; no DSL target.

units.disclosure: Weather vanes may rise up to 1.0 m above a garden suite's height limit; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Skylights on the roof of a garden suite building may exceed its permitted maximum height by 0.3 metres.
calculation_handling.gaps: Rooftop element projection; no DSL target.

units.disclosure: Skylights may rise up to 0.3 m above a garden suite's height limit; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Equipment for the functional operation of a garden suite building (electrical, utility, mechanical, ventilation) on its roof may exceed its permitted maximum height by 1.0 metre, subject to (6).
calculation_handling.gaps: Rooftop element projection; no DSL target.

units.disclosure: Rooftop mechanical equipment may rise up to 1.0 m above a garden suite's height limit, within the (6) limits; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Functional structures or parts of a garden suite building (enclosed stairwells, roof access, maintenance storage, chimneys, vents, water supply) may exceed its permitted maximum height by 1.0 metre, subject to (6).
calculation_handling.gaps: Rooftop element projection; no DSL target.

units.disclosure: Rooftop stair enclosures, chimneys and vents may rise up to 1.0 m above a garden suite's height limit, within the (6) limits; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Structures that enclose, screen or cover the (A) and (B) elements may exceed the garden suite building's permitted maximum height by 1.0 metre, subject to (6).
calculation_handling.gaps: Rooftop element projection; no DSL target.

units.disclosure: Screens around rooftop equipment may rise up to 1.0 m above a garden suite's height limit; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Rooftop functional equipment and structures permitted by (5) must not cover more than 30 percent of the roof area, measured horizontally.
calculation_handling.gaps: A numeric limit on rooftop equipment coverage with no DSL target (lot_coverage_pct is lot coverage, not roof coverage), so keyed UNUSUAL. The unit text says 'an ancillary building' (the garden suite building by reference to (5)).

units.disclosure: Rooftop equipment on a garden suite may cover at most 30% of the roof; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Rooftop functional equipment and structures permitted by (5) must not be closer than 1.0 metre to the main walls of the ancillary building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Set-in from the main walls has no DSL target (encroachment_clearance_m is measured from a lot line), so keyed UNUSUAL.

units.disclosure: Rooftop equipment on a garden suite must be set in at least 1.0 m from the walls; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Regulation 10.5.60.40(4) (ancillary building entrance height) does not apply to an ancillary building containing a garden suite.

150.7.60.40(1).explanation: A garden suite can be up to 4.0 m tall if it is less than 7.5 m from the house, or up to 6.3 m tall if it is 7.5 m or more away.

150.7.60.40(2).explanation: A garden suite can have up to two storeys, within the height limits above.

150.7.60.40(3).explanation: Antennae, flagpoles, satellite dishes, weather vanes and green-roof parapets (set back 1.0 m from the walls) may rise up to 1.0 m above the garden suite's height limit.

150.7.60.40(4).explanation: Skylights may rise up to 0.3 m above the garden suite's height limit.

150.7.60.40(5).explanation: Rooftop mechanical equipment, stair and roof-access enclosures, chimneys, vents and their screens may rise up to 1.0 m above the garden suite's height limit.

150.7.60.40(6).explanation: That rooftop equipment may cover no more than 30% of the roof and must be at least 1.0 m in from the outer walls.

150.7.60.40(7).explanation: The general limit on the height of an ancillary building's entrance does not apply to garden suites.
